orphan_keys.title: Unresolved entity keys found
orphan_keys.message: {{keys}} tag key(s) in {{files}} file(s) no longer match any entity in this database.
orphan_keys.linked_detail:
This project is linked to a central database. If a matching project-database update is still arriving from your sync drive, leave the keys intact and reopen after sync settles.

Otherwise:
• Ingest stubs — recreate minimal entities from the tagged names in the corpus (keeps the same ids; authority links cannot be restored from the corpus alone).
• Strip orphan keys — remove the dangling ids; tags stay.{{strayNote}}
orphan_keys.local_detail:
This usually means the database was rolled back or hand-edited.

• Ingest stubs — recreate minimal entities from the tagged names (keeps the same ids; no authority metadata).
• Strip orphan keys — remove the dangling ids; tags stay.
• Leave intact — restore from Time Machine instead.{{strayNote}}
orphan_keys.stray_note: {{count}} file(s) appear to belong to a different project database and were left untouched.

nameTypePolicy.intro: 第一階段＝首次標記炸彈掃描。第二階段＝人物連結後的簡稱掃描。永不＝儲存但不自動標記（例如姓）。
nameTypePolicy.primary_warning: 主要姓名通常會在第一階段標記。將主要姓名設為第二階段或永不，可能導致首次掃描遺漏許多人物提及。
nameTypePolicy.art_length_hint: 依長度限制：較短的號會進入第二階段（≥ {{count}} 個代碼點 → 第一階段）
nameTypePolicy.custom_intro: 專案專用類型（ASCII id slug）。遵循相同的第一階段／第二階段／永不規則。
